purpose: Predeclare what each candidate propagation/buffering mechanism would have to look like across the currently admitted island cases before new measurements are used to promote any mechanism into the ABM.

required_signature: direct effective service is low or reduced
reproductive output is maintained relative to an explicit capacity denominator
autonomous reproduction is high in the same matched units
buffering weakens where autonomous reproduction is low after direct service is accounted for
candidate_predictions.would_be_weakened_by: repeated buffering under low service in units with low autonomous reproduction or high direct pollinator dependency

required_signature: pollinator composition or functional exposure changes
direct rate-weighted effective service remains stable or is compensated
reproductive output remains stable
the compensating visitor groups have measured visit rate and per-visit effectiveness rather than occurrence alone
candidate_predictions.would_be_weakened_by: buffering when direct effective service is clearly reduced and no compensating service channel is measured

required_signature: an upstream service or interaction-quality deficit is directly measured
autonomous assurance and direct service are measured sufficiently to exclude them as the sole buffer
a resource or demographic process responds to the perturbation in the same units
the measured compensatory process predicts or experimentally restores reproductive performance
candidate_predictions.would_be_weakened_by: resource change that is not linked to reproductive maintenance after assurance and direct service are separated

required_signature: island trait or assurance differences exist without a measured current service deficit
independent colonization, establishment, or survivorship history varies across units
the trait or assurance difference tracks the establishment history better than current pollinator shortage
current service and reproductive state are measured rather than inferred from syndrome
candidate_predictions.would_be_weakened_by: the same trait shift repeatedly emerges within established native populations in direct response to current service loss

required_signature: upstream functional exposure is similar or changes in a known way
realized interaction support or partner identity differs
visitor-specific direct effectiveness converts the network difference into different effective service
the effective-service difference predicts downstream propagation state
candidate_predictions.would_be_weakened_by: branching that persists when matched network support and direct effective service are equivalent

decision_rules_for_future_data: A candidate can be described as source-supported before ABM admission, as with Hawaiʻi autonomous assurance.
A source-supported candidate cannot be encoded as empirically identified merely because it explains a known buffered outcome retrospectively.
If more than one candidate signature remains compatible, classify the buffer as unresolved rather than fitting all candidates.
If a candidate reaches mapping-ready status, freeze the mapping and pass/fail target before testing downstream outcome.
If the predeclared test fails, retain the failure and reopen only with genuinely new independent evidence, not retuning on the same target.
current_result: no_single_buffer_mechanism_is_empirically_admitted; autonomous assurance is narrowed as a Hawaiʻi exact-taxon candidate for two Clermontia species but remains untested in the 2026 matched context
claim_boundary: These are qualitative mechanism-discrimination predictions. They do not assume effect-size commensurability across islands and do not make any candidate universal.
